title: JIBALI — من قلب الجبل، لقلب البيت. (Pruna cinematic version)

clips.prompt: The hoopoe flies smoothly across the frame from left to right high above the valley, with the snow-capped summit of Jabal al-Sheikh behind it; natural undulating flight with real wingbeats, gentle slow aerial camera drift, sunrise light through the haze. Realistic physics, the bird keeps the same appearance.

The hoopoe touches down on the limestone rock, its feet grip the stone, it folds its barred wings and raises its fan-shaped crest; ripe wheat sways softly in the breeze. Slow cinematic push-in. Realistic physics.

The upper millstone turns slowly and steadily, kernels trickle into the eye, whole-wheat flour pours gently from the rim into the trough, dust drifts through the light beams. Static camera with a very slight push-in.

A small stream of water is poured into the flour, then both hands press and fold the dough with the heels of the palms in a steady rhythm. Natural hand movement, stable fingers, the bowl stays still. No extra ingredients.
The thin saj bread bakes on the hot dome: small bubbles rise and turn golden-brown, faint heat shimmer, the small wood fire flickers below. Slow cinematic push-in. The bread stays paper-thin.
